questions.stem: During an intensive larval survey in a rural village, public health officials inspected 70 houses and found Aedes aegypti larvae in 8 of them. Additionally, a total of 82 containers were examined, and larvae were present in 19 of these containers. Based on these findings, what is the Breteau Index (BI) for this village?
